prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.4 °C (30% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.8 °C (24% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.1 °C (21% above healthy). Heat exchanger effectiveness has dropped below optimal threshold, producing elevated mean temperatures.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.43 l/min (2% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 384 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.7 % (3% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
